faq_heading: Homes near Seaquam Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Seaquam Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Seaquam Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active houses, townhomes and condos whose listing description names Seaquam Secondary. MLS® listings are not tagged by school, so a nearby home whose listing does not name the school will not show, and a listing that does can be farther than 2 km away.

faq.q: How much do homes near Seaquam Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 275 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,265,000, townhomes $760,000, condos $482,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Seaquam Secondary?
faq.a: The median was 29 days on the market, closing at 96.8% of the list price, with 8% of sales above the list price for the 275 homes within 2 km.

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Seaquam Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Seaquam Secondary sold for

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Seaquam Secondary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Delta school finder. A home a few blocks from Seaquam Secondary can sit in a different catchment.

Walk the route to Seaquam Secondary the way a child would, and count the crossings and sidewalks.
